title: Watch: Burnham 'gets it' says Trump, as the two leaders meet for first time
description: Donald Trump says he can do business with Andy Burnham at their first face-to-face meeting in New York, but criticises the "terrible" Chagos deal.

title: Plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community disrupted, say police
description: Two men were arrested in Manchester on Sunday, say counter-terror police.

title: Tim Westwood charged with two more sexual offences
description: The alleged sexual offences date back to 1991 and 2004.

title: Earl Spencer should pull Diana book from shelves, Piers Morgan says
description: Princess Diana's brother apologised to Morgan for a factual error in his memoir. Morgan said he is "pursuing legal action" against Spencer.

title: Father admits causing death of his son in hotel fall
description: The two-year-old boy fell from the window of a hotel in Cyprus in July, a Paphos court hears.

title: Booker Prize judges reveal shortlisted novels after selection 'tussle'
description: Past Booker winners Marlon James and Douglas Stuart are among the nominees for this year's award.

title: Lib Dems leave conference buoyed by Davey's message
description: Concerns over Sir Ed Davey's leadership were dampened by pledges at conference and his performance.

title: Autopsy shows Hayden Panettiere died from a drug overdose
description: The death of the child star - who had fentanyl, Xanax, a muscle relaxant and antipsychotic medication in her system -  was ruled an accident.

title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
description: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.
